text: Couldn't get out of bed until 11 again. Not tired exactly, just heavy. Skipped my morning lecture.
Lunch with Mia. She asked how I'm doing and I said fine but I felt like I was watching myself from far away. Chest felt tight the whole time.
Lay awake until 3. My head keeps replaying the group project meeting where I froze when it was my turn to talk.
Stopped going to climbing. Used to be my favourite thing. Now it just feels like effort.
Mum called. I got irritated over nothing and hung up. Felt guilty after. idk, just off.
Booked my first psychiatry appointment. I want them to understand it's not just stress, but every time I try to explain it the words disappear.
